title: Keyoxide instance directory
description: The list of Keyoxide deployments and the operator keys that claim them.

$schema.description: Editor hint; points at this file.

instance.description: The Keyoxide deployment this entry lists. Verified against the dns proofs on the operator's key, which must cover this URL's host.

signature.description: Base64 of a detached OpenPGP signature by this key over "keyoxide-directory listing v1\ninstance=<instance>\n". The operator asking to be listed; checked by `npm run verify:entries`, never by the page.

hkpSource.description: The key on keys.openpgp.org, looked up by fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: Long key id (16 hex) or full fingerprint (40 hex). Short key ids are rejected as collision-prone.

wkdSource.description: The key in a domain's Web Key Directory. Carries the hashed local part, never the address itself. Needs the serving host to send CORS headers.

domain.description: The domain half of the operator's address, which WKD needs in the clear to build a URL.

hash.description: The z-base-32 SHA-1 of the lowercased local part. Compute it with `npm run wkd-hash <address>`.

daneSource.description: The key as an RFC 7929 OPENPGPKEY record. Needs nothing of the operator's web server, but the zone must be DNSSEC-signed.

domain.description: The domain half of the operator's address, which the record name is built from.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the lowercased local part, truncated to 28 octets, in lowercase hex. Compute it with `npm run dane-hash <address>`.

source.description: One place the operator's key can be fetched from.

entry.description: A deployment, the operator's consent to list it, and where their key can be found.

sources.description: Tried dane, then wkd, then hkp, whatever order they are written in. They must all be the same key; `verify:entries` checks that.
